warning: SYNTHETIC ESTIMATES. No aerial tracing, survey, measured stall count, legal parking designation or completeness claim. Layout and count may differ substantially from reality.

assumptions.layout: Minimum rotated rectangle orientation and perpendicular orientation; test eight grid phases each; double-loaded rows with adjacent local aisle containment.
assumptions.selection: Only whole polygons within bbox explicitly tagged parking=surface; no garages, roofs, underground facilities, building-tagged lots, unknown surface types or on-street estimates.
not_modeled: unmapped landscape islands, trees, sidewalks and obstacles
current construction or changes since OSM mapping
assumptions.official_rule_join: None. No Duke facility facts, rules, fees or permits assigned to model footprints.
